usedFor: MailChimp collects subscribers and Podio stores them as items through “Create Item” after each new audience signup.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new subscriber is added to an audience” in MailChimp, then “Create Item” in Podio
bestTemplate.why: Each signup lands in a Podio app, so your team can work the list where tasks already live.

watchOut: “Send Campaign” in MailChimp reaches subscribers outside your business, so it waits in Needs you for approval.
